# CANDIDATE: GAP_FADE_SHORT_VIX_FILTER

**Filed:** 2026-07-21  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Large gap-ups (≥0.5%) tend to fill when volatility is elevated (VIX > 22), providing a short-bias fade opportunity. This edge exists because heightened VIX indicates fear-driven mean reversion, increasing the probability that gap-up momentum exhausts and price retraces to the prior close as traders take profit or volatility compresses.

## Mechanism

Entry: If opening price > previous close × 1.005 (gap-up ≥0.5%) AND VIX > 22, enter short at the open (or first 5-min bar). Stop placed above the gap high (intrabar high of the opening bar). Exit: Primary chart-stop at gap high, TP1 at previous close (gap fill), runner trail using ATR×2 if price continues lower. Regime filter: Only active between 09:30-10:00 ET, avoiding scheduled news releases (FOMC, CPI, NFP, mega-cap earnings).
